Question Choices: For 13x ≡ 8 (mod 23), find the least positive integer solution.
Hints: Divide the coefficient, right-hand side, and modulus by their GCD before solving.
Solution: gcd(13,23) = 1. Divide by 1: 13x ≡ 8 (mod 23). Inverting 13 modulo 23 gives x ≡ 13 (mod 23). The requested solution is 13.
